scope.sourceShape: One known relevant candidate at ordinal 73 plus neutral indexed candidates; no network, model, personal data or delivery.

claims: The current indexed selector found the known relevant detail in all 1800 enabled samples across the three corpus sizes, with no deadline fallback.
The measured local selection p95 stayed below the 10 ms optional-selection objective in warm, background and cold conditions for all corpus sizes.

This is local indexed-selection and prompt-assembly evidence only. It does not qualify a selected model/provider, first useful token, audible timing, barge-in, physical audio, production or Human acceptance. The raw report is retained outside Git at .lifestream/benchmarks/discovery-local/2026-09-16/s084-local-corpus-current.json (SHA-256 71c5deeb74a7c4cc56e0af59d4aa111f2e88097067b315fb0a176a67facb3127).
limitations: Synthetic direct database seeding does not certify admission, source acquisition, provider analysis or live conversation.
The benchmark does not close LS-COMP-064, selected-provider qualification, protected external authority, S083 delivery, production or Human acceptance.
